title: Signoz vs Datadog: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Signoz vs Datadog: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

- Throughput: Compare ingest rates and data handling capabilities under heavy load.
- Latency: Analyze query response times and data collection delays.
- Consistency: Evaluate data accuracy and reliability across different scenarios.
- Failure Modes: Understand how each system handles outages and errors.
- Operational Overhead: Assess the complexity of deployment, maintenance, and resource utilization.

Recommendation: For production environments prioritizing cost-effectiveness and open-source flexibility, Signoz often presents a compelling alternative. Datadog excels in feature breadth and enterprise support, but at a higher cost.
